name: MyTV
tagline: Watch live TV and IPTV channels on your phone or TV
description:
MyTV is a live TV and IPTV player for Android and Android TV, built with a modern Material 3 look. It plays M3U playlists and Xtream or stalker-portal sources, and switches between Media3, IJKplayer, and VLC playback engines depending on what a channel needs.

It is built for TV boxes and living-room screens as much as phones, so it works well with a remote control if you have one.
